Attached Form 8
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Attached Form 8] <Amended on October 1, 2025>

APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION OF AN ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATOR TRAINING INSTITUTION

The applicant shall not complete the dark-shaded fields.

Receipt number: __________
Date of receipt: __________
Processing date: __________
Processing period: 30 days

Applicant
Institution name: __________
Name of representative: __________
Address: __________
Telephone number: __________
Email address: __________
Mobile telephone number: __________

Application details
Name of the training institution: __________
Name of representative: __________
Location of the training institution: __________
Training grade: __________

I hereby apply for designation of an environmental educator training institution under Article 19 of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education, Article 16(2) of its Enforcement Decree, and Article 7(1) of its Enforcement Rule.

Year ____ Month ____ Day ____
Applicant: __________ (signature or seal)

To: Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

Accompanying documents
1. One copy of an education plan, including courses for training specialized personnel.
2. Documents concerning the teaching personnel, educational facilities and equipment held that are necessary for training specialized personnel.

Fee: None

Processing procedure
Preparation of the application → Receipt → Verification → Approval → Issuance of the certificate of designation of an environmental educator training institution.

Applicant: preparation of the application.
Processing authorities: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries (departments responsible for environmental education).
